purpose: Establish which gate classes tolerate a reduced checkout, by running real gates against reduced checkouts rather than reasoning about them.

probes.reduced_checkout: cone-mode sparse checkout: worker tools .github test
probes.gate: Worker unit family (node --test in worker/, per .github/workflows/ci.yml)
probes.cause: worker/src reaches across the package boundary into site/. The first failure is worker/src/lib/confirm_email.mjs importing site/community_board_watch.mjs.
probes.significance: A worker-only cone is not a valid profile for Worker card work. Any sparse profile proposal that assumes package-shaped isolation is wrong for this repository.

probes.reduced_checkout: non-cone sparse checkout: everything except site/data, plus the site/data files named by static analysis, then extended by iterating against the gate
probes.cause: The needed set is not statically derivable. Static import analysis found 22 site/data dependencies; running the gate revealed further paths loaded at runtime through filesystem reads (for example site/data/legal_code/manifest.json, site/data/land_procedure_profiles.json, site/data/abo_award_residual_lookup.json, site/data/source_contracts.json) which no import-specifier scan can see.
probes.significance: Sparse profiles are achievable but require a maintained, gate-verified path manifest. Deriving one from source analysis alone silently under-includes and breaks a required gate.

probes.reduced_checkout: cone-mode sparse checkout: worker tools .github test
probes.significance: The static-standards family reads the tracked site/ payload and requires it present.

probes.reduced_checkout: none (full checkout, same clone with sparse-checkout disabled)
probes.detail: capability topology, API catalog, and MCP catalog are current
probes.significance: Control: the failure above is attributable to the reduced checkout, not to the clone or the environment.

cross_boundary_measurements.note: The iteration was stopped after three rounds without convergence. The unconverged state is itself the finding and is reported rather than hidden.

full_checkout_requirements.shallow_clone_blocked_by: Three checkout steps in .github/workflows/ci.yml pin fetch-depth: 0. The legacy repository-name guard resolves a merge-base against main, which a depth-1 clone cannot satisfy. Two other workflows (merge-pipeline-guard, cold-build-canary) already use fetch-depth: 1 and are unaffected.
gate_classes_requiring_the_full_tracked_: static-standards family (reads the tracked site/ payload; 141 tools reference site/data)
accessibility and browser families (serve the built site)
the generated site build itself (node tools/build_cloudflare_pages.mjs)
